recommendation: Keep this source change. It completes the accepted FHIR-31544 prominence fix for the active ClinicalUseDefinition successor of ClinicalUseIssue without adding new explanatory prose or touching retired/out-of-build substance resources.
issue_request: FHIR-31544 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification BRR issue for R5 asking for guidance and examples for the Medication Definition resources. Jira comments narrowed the accepted change to making the existing module-page pointer more discoverable, and the final resolution was to add a box around that comment and pointer.
initial_application: The issue was partially applied in history. Commits 51de7da27f and 9e7578c16a made the module-page pointer bold/italic across the Medication Definition introductions, including ClinicalUseDefinition. Follow-up FHIR-31544 commits such as 0fe8846287, 8c23667a03, and ca41714f0e added the gray bordered box style to other active Medication Definition resource introductions, but the current active ClinicalUseDefinition introduction still had only the bold/italic pointer.
additional_context: The seed's ClinicalUseIssue artifact maps to the current ClinicalUseDefinition resource after FHIR-31847. source/fhir.ini actively lists ClinicalUseDefinition and the medication-definition resources that carry the same pointer, while the current medication-definition module page remains the full overview target. BRR minutes reference FHIR-31544 in Medication Resources ballot reconciliation, and no Zulip hit was found that changes the Jira/source-history conclusion.
reconciliation: Applied the same existing bordered paragraph style used by the other active Medication Definition resource introductions to the ClinicalUseDefinition module-page pointer. This is a narrow narrative-source fix in a build-scoped resource and does not change any conformance semantics.
